data.narrative:
Maritime Fusion is a seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Justin Cohen and Jason Kaufmann that has raised $4.5M to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms, with relevant peers including Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy.

Given the early stage and nascent investor base in frontier nuclear, traditional peer-median valuation proves inapplicable here. The comp set exists but lacks sufficient same-stage or valuation-tier clustering—only one same-stage peer and one adjacent-stage peer were identified, falling short of the three-datapoint threshold needed for statistical reliability. Consequently, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $4.5M raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $11.25M.

The triangulated range supported by this single applicable method spans $9.6M to $13M, with a central estimate of $11M. This range reflects the baseline methodology applied without cross-validation from comparable transaction data. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for nuclear-sector dynamics, capital efficiency relative to sector peers, and the timing and terms of the next financing round. A denser peer dataset at similar stages would substantially strengthen conviction in any valuation point within this range.
